scope: Read-only reference study for Augusto's Apple-dominant presentation and persistent booking access.
methods: Direct public HTML, CSS and JavaScript inspection

sources.access: Read successfully through Jina and direct HTML.

observed.evidence: Homepage markup supplies a looping property video, a landscape property photograph, interiors, accommodation, service and dining chapters, then experience links.
observed.augustoApplication: Use real Augusto rooms, lobby and dining images as the main narrative. Put destination photography in clearly labelled city sections.

observed.evidence: The source separates hotel, suites, rooms, dining, services, experiences and photography, with practical information and policies accessible separately.
observed.augustoApplication: Retain meaningful separate hotel, rooms, dining, Varanasi, gallery, guide and contact routes. Add group enquiries as a concrete guest task.

observed.pattern: Reservation access remains distinct from storytelling
observed.evidence: A book-now trigger controls an aside#bookOverlay containing arrival, departure and guest inputs. Its handoff targets booking.casangelina.com. Room-detail booking also carries a room identifier.
observed.augustoApplication: Use the user's explicitly requested universal date dock, preserve dates and room preference across routes, and prepare a WhatsApp enquiry. The dock is an Augusto requirement; this source does not establish that Casa Angelina displays persistent date fields.

observed.evidence: The inspected suite page combines genuine photography, a property-specific description, room facts, services, a room-specific reservation action and related accommodation.
observed.augustoApplication: Keep the actual Augusto category galleries, verified bed arrangements, shared amenities, room-prefilled enquiry and related categories. Omit unsupported sizes, capacity and views.

observed.evidence: The concept page describes restrained white interiors framed by the real coastal setting. The stylesheet uses a white background with muted brown text and several display families including LM Roman and Geometria.
observed.augustoApplication: Take the restrained interface and large photographic emphasis. Keep Augusto's approved Inter, cool neutrals and cobalt actions; do not reintroduce the rejected serif/brown system.

interactionRecommendations: Keep the global date dock visually separate from main content and reserve its exact height, including mobile safe-area space.
Use clearly labelled arrival and departure fields and one Check availability action. Explain that the hotel confirms availability on WhatsApp.
Retain native scrolling and a keyboard-accessible mobile menu. Avoid copying the reference's elaborate scroll machinery.
Use short photo crossfades, restrained hover/focus feedback and once-only reveals. Keep booking access immediate with reduced motion.
Preserve selections when following a room link or returning from the enquiry form; avoid duplicated independent date states.
doNotTransfer: Casa Angelina branding, photographs, written marketing copy or visual artwork.
Its awards, affiliations, room count, adult-only rules, terrace sizes, private experiences, cuisine, direct-rate guarantees or other hotel-specific claims.
Its serif typography, brown accent, letter-spaced slogans, long transition delays or scroll-hijacking conventions.
A live-availability or completed-booking claim while Augusto has only a WhatsApp enquiry handoff.
accessLimits: No browser was launched because the root agent owned the active QA slot.
No fresh screenshot, responsive rendering, keyboard behaviour, scroll performance or booking submission was tested.
CSS and HTML establish structure and declared treatments; final rendered composition and transition quality remain unverified for this reference.
The reference booking engine was not opened or submitted.
changesMade: Research JSON only. No Augusto application or sibling-project files changed for this study.
